findings.reason: Register inconsistency across the page: description and metaDescription use the formal plural imperative (yükleyin/onarın) while extendedDescription, howToUse and FAQ all use the informal singular (yükle, tıkla, ayarlayabilirsin), which also matches the required 'You → Sen' convention.
Product-UI terms left in English; the required translations are Queue → Kuyruk and Execute → Yürüt.
Incorrect vowel harmony in the suffix: 'LoRA' is pronounced with a back vowel, so the accusative suffix should be -yı, not -yi.
Inconsistent rendering of 'grain' across the page: 'gren' in extendedDescription, 'taneciklenme' in suggestedUseCases, and untranslated 'grain' here.
Incorrect possessive suffix after the proper noun; Turkish convention for 'ComfyUI' (read ending in a vowel sound) is 'ComfyUI'nin'.

Formality inconsistency: the rest of the page (extendedDescription, howToUse) uses the informal second person ('istediğin', 'yükle', 'kullan'), matching the required 'You → Sen' register, while the FAQ answers switch to formal 'siz' forms ('ihtiyacınız', 'aboneliğinize').
Inconsistent rendering of 'image to video' within the same entry: the title and extendedDescription use 'görüntüden videoya' while the metaDescription uses 'görselden videoya'.
The page is inconsistent in rendering 'image': the title/description/howToUse/FAQ use 'görsel' while extendedDescription uses 'görüntü'. One term should be used throughout the entry.
'Text rendering' is translated as 'metin oluşturma' in the description but as 'metin işleme' here, creating inconsistent terminology within the same entry.
'Presets' is rendered 'hazır ayarlar' in extendedDescription/howToUse but 'ön ayarlar' in the FAQ; inconsistent within the entry.
English says 'dialog text'; the translation drops 'text', weakening the point that the model renders readable text in UI mockups.
